description: Find a manufacturer safety data sheet (SDS) by product name or manufacturer, using the same lookup that powers SDSentry's free /sds-search page plus matching sheets already in SDSentry's shared SDS library. Returns up to 5 matches with product, manufacturer, revision date when recorded, the SDS PDF link and a public page to view or print it. A product that cannot be identified reliably is reported as not found, never guessed. Read-only, free, no signup.

query.description: Product name and/or manufacturer, e.g. "WD-40" or "Clorox bleach".

name: search_sds
title: Search safety data sheets (SDS) by product or manufacturer
